Zapsat poslední aktivitu do deníku: Log the latest activity in the diary
Kde běh zatěžuje tělo · 7 dní: Where running loads the body · 7 days
Procento = jak plná je kapacita oblasti: Percentage = how full the region's capacity is over the last 7 days (100 % = ceiling). How the load is split between regions is the app's working model: distance loads mainly the knee, shin and IT band, pace the Achilles tendon, calf and foot (Nielsen et al., 2014), descent the front of the thigh and the knee, ascent the calf and glutes (Vernillo et al., 2017). Ring = a spot where you reported pain in the last 14 days.
zelený pás = vaše obvyklé rozmezí, tečka: green band = your usual range, dot = recent runs
